## Description

Please provide a summary of the changes and the related issue/feature motivation.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] UI/UX improvement (styling, animation, layout)
- [ ] Performance optimization
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist

- [ ] My code compiles cleanly without errors or warnings (`swift build`)
- [ ] I have tested this change locally on macOS
- [ ] I have verified keyboard-only navigation continues to work seamlessly
- [ ] No new third-party dependencies, network requests, or telemetry were introduced
- [ ] Accessibility permission handling is preserved
